shots.excerpt: Wide establishing shot from just above ice level, very slow drift: she stands small at the center of a misty frozen lake, six mages in a ring, blue energy glowing around their hands.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A wide shot from just above the ice. Six mages circle her, their hands glowing blue.

shots.excerpt: Medium close-up over the blurred shoulder of a mage, very slow push-in: cool, confident gaze, red hair lifting in the wind, a mocking half-smile.
shots.voice: Shot 2. An over-the-shoulder close-up with a slow push-in. Her calm smile is the threat.

shots.excerpt: Low tracking shot: the blast explodes in blue mist and ice shards; she slides low across the ice on one knee, sword held out behind her.
shots.voice: Shot 5. A low tracking shot. The blast explodes behind her and she slides out of it on the ice.

shots.excerpt: She drives the sword point into the ice; a crackling wave of cyan energy veins rips across the surface and hurls a mage backward.

shots.voice: Shot 11. One stab into the ice sends a wave of glowing blue cracks across the lake.
